compatibility.unknown_build_policy: recognized records are candidates with unverified build status; missing or ambiguous fields cannot change authoritative state

update_contract.activation: explicit user approval, then next Wingman startup before monitoring
update_contract.rollback: keep last-known-good complete JSON; never merge partial versions

record_contract.timestamp: parse optional fractional seconds and retain UTC; failure produces missing source timestamp, not a fabricated now timestamp
record_contract.notification: extract complete quoted notification payload; support physical and escaped newlines; preserve payload punctuation
record_contract.ambiguity: reject conflicting rule matches; diagnostics never masquerade as gameplay events
record_contract.required_field_failure: retain incomplete candidate locally; no authoritative state mutation or outward notification

money_transfer.unrelated_record: discard pending and parse new record normally
money_transfer.record_size_and_timeout_limits: fixed engine limits; values must be established by replay before implementation

operator_contracts.match: Boolean all/any/not of literal/regex conditions against record or extracted notification text; no state access. All matches are considered; conflicting public event types are ambiguous rather than first-match wins.
operator_contracts.capture: Regex search with explicit numbered capture-to-field assignments. No match leaves fields absent. DOTALL is only used on an already bounded complete record.
operator_contracts.bracket_fields: Extract named key[value] fields independently of order; tolerate whitespace before brackets and optional colon. No silent global case folding or substring aliases.
operator_contracts.constant: Assign a JSON literal to a field.
operator_contracts.normalize: Finite sequence of trim, remove_commas, int, float, lower, replace, split_once, regex_replace operations. Invalid conversions produce a field error, never zero.
operator_contracts.choose: Ordered alternatives local to one event recipe, using the same finite match vocabulary; no arbitrary expressions, loops, imports or function names.
operator_contracts.collect_true_fields: Read a bounded declared list of name:true flags into an object. Absence is not evidence of false.
operator_contracts.notification_context: Extract notification ID, MissionId and ObjectiveId from the complete record. IDs are evidence fields, not assumed stable event classifiers.
operator_contracts.exclude_values: Reject a record when an extracted field belongs to a named finite exclusion set; absent required discriminator is incomplete.
operator_contracts.quantity_with_unit: Extract number and unit separately, normalize only explicitly declared units; missing/unknown unit stays unresolved.
operator_contracts.notification_payload: Use an explicit notification label and bounded text payload; remove only a declared legacy terminator, preserving internal punctuation.
operator_contracts.sequence: Bounded record assembly, not game-state reasoning. Track start/continuation/end within one file generation; flush incomplete on next independent record, timeout, rotation or size limit.

tier2_handler_contracts.session: Track file generation/player/session; suppress only evidenced duplicate session records; reset scoped missions, pending transactions and injuries with explicit handling of stale ship/location state.
tier2_handler_contracts.missions: Mission-ID keyed lifecycle, objective assignment/completion, zero-ID handling, recent completed-mission context; no mission closure from a word in payload.
tier2_handler_contracts.health: Normalize body parts; update/heal injuries; armistice-triggered reminders. An unknown part is not a reason to erase all injuries.
tier2_handler_contracts.locations: Resolve names/system; learn GUID/name pairs within the current 60s/15s windows; departure from Location.from only, excluding zero; preserve arrival dedup and re-arrival behavior; scope learned identifiers by environment/build.
tier2_handler_contracts.ships: Derive ship entry/exit and owner from channel; qualify ship-specific observations before public emission. Current overlapping model tokens and missing-class fail-open are a known accuracy limitation, not a guarantee.
tier2_handler_contracts.zones: Apply explicit armistice/restricted/monitored/jurisdiction transitions. Unknown direction does not mean exited or entered.
tier2_handler_contracts.trades: Keep item requests pending, correlate result by scoped identity and occurrence, handle duplicates/timeouts; retain evidence strength; conversion of units/currency and ledger commit live here. Ambiguous candidate sets stay unresolved.
tier2_handler_contracts.rewards: Validate money versus physical quantity, associate mission context, bundle/deduplicate components with event time and provenance; keep unknown unit/amount out of confirmed financial totals.
tier2_handler_contracts.movement: Record cargo/refinery/equipment/insurance observations without inventing completion; distinguish event time, observation time, source and confidence.
tier2_handler_contracts.passthrough: Forward a validated event to existing subscriptions with stable event name/data shape; optional context does not invent state.
